title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. font-queri
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. font-queri, commonly known as the Globe Clover, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in wound healing and reducing oxidative stress. The Globe Clover has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions including antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it a potential remedy for skin infections and other microbial-related issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
